label.purpose: Reference numbers, section marks, field labels. Mono, uppercase, 0.16em tracking.

shadows.name: document-lift
shadows.purpose: The hero credential card only. One shadow per page; everything else is flat.

motion.name: stamp-in
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out. The hero credential card settles onto the page once on load.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button and link colour changes on hover/focus. The only other motion in the system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on light grounds. Darkens to brass on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #100f0d; color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6d4c1f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ab7c2e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The lower-emphasis companion action. Hairline border, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #423f39; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid #b3b1ab; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #100f0d; border-color: #100f0d; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ab7c2e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Discipline Chip
components.description: Static taxonomy of disciplines served. Not a filter — it does not select.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #faf9f7; color: #55524a; border: 1px solid #d7d6d2; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Credential Label
components.description: The system's fine print: reference numbers, section marks, field labels.
components.css: .ds-cred-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #6b685f; margin: 0; }

components.name: Seal
components.description: The system's signature mark. Inherits currentColor so one component serves brass-on-paper and brass-on-ink.

narrative.overview:
Datafore sells clarity to people who already live inside a professional credentialing system. Physiotherapists, chiropractors, and counsellors hold registrations, carry licence numbers, and are audited against standards. The system borrows that world: a clinic's performance is presented as something issued, referenced, and standing — a record with a seal and a number on it — rather than as a dashboard of floating charts.

The surface behaves like good printed stationery. A warm paper ground, hairline rules, ink-black text, and a single brass accent used the way a foil seal is used: sparingly, and only where authority is being asserted. Density is calm and documentary. Nothing glows, nothing floats without reason, and the page never tries to look like the product it is describing.

The confirmed anti-reference is the generic analytics landing page this replaced: Inter, a saturated blue, pill-shaped buttons, a grid of identical icon-heading-text cards, eyebrow labels above every heading, and numbered 01 / 02 / 03 steps.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground, ink text, one brass accent — no second accent hue.
Square-cornered or barely-rounded geometry; no pills.
Engraved circular seals as the recurring mark.
Tracked monospace micro-labels carrying reference numbers.
Hairline rules and shared borders instead of scattered drop shadows.

rules.name: The Foil Rule
rules.body: Brass is a seal, not a paint. It marks, outlines, and labels; it never fills a region larger than a button. If a brass area reads as a background, it has broken the metaphor.

rules.name: The Fine Print Floor
rules.body: ink-500 is the lightest ink permitted for text on paper, and ink-400 the lightest on ink-950. Both clear 4.5:1. Anything lighter is decoration pretending to be content.

rules.name: The Darken-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Every filled button darkens on hover. Lightening a brass button drops it below AA against white — this is a measured constraint, not a preference.

rules.name: The Number Rule
rules.body: Anything that reads as an identifier — REG. NO., CRED. NO., a date, a metric — is set in Plex Mono. Prose is never mono, and identifiers are never prose.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No kicker or eyebrow label sits above a heading. The heading carries its own weight. Mono labels mark sections and fields, never introduce a headline.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Exactly one element per page may cast a shadow. If a second appears, the first has stopped being special and the page has become a card wall.

dos: Do carry every identifier — reference numbers, dates, metrics, field labels — in Plex Mono uppercase with 0.16em tracking, via .credential-label.
Do separate sections with a ground change (paper -> paper-dim -> ink-950) closed by an ink-200 hairline.
Do build card grids as a 1px gap over an ink-200 ground so cards share rules like a table.
Do darken filled buttons on hover, never lighten them.
Do label any illustrative figure as a sample in-place, in mono fine print. The product has no customers yet and the design must never imply otherwise.
Do route internal links and public/ asset URLs through withBase() — the site is served from a subpath on the Pages preview.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue. The system is ink plus brass; a status colour needs a deliberate decision, not a new Tailwind token.
Don't use rounded-full on anything that is not a seal or a status dot. No pills.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker label above a heading.
Don't number sequential sections 01 / 02 / 03. The stages carry mono word marks (CONNECT / VERIFY / CERTIFY) because the words are the information.
Don't add a second shadow to a page, or use a zero-offset coloured glow as depth.
Don't set text lighter than ink-500 on paper or ink-400 on ink-950.
Don't use emoji or icon fonts. Icons are authored SVG in the seal's stroke language.
